target_customer: Small and medium businesses in Latin America
problem: SMBs in Latam lack timely, accurate financial statements; Boton uses an autonomous agent with a partner accountant reviewing books.
business_model: B2B SaaS with accountant review; pricing not found

founders.name: Alvaro Sosa
founders.background_notes: Hero launch post says he managed expenses at a remote company where staff sent receipts over WhatsApp and built a no-front-end tool that saved about two hours per week.

founders.name: Fernando Varela
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as an ex quant.

competitors.name: Contabilizei
competitors.what: Online accounting firm for Brazilian SMBs
competitors.funding_then: Reported $60M to $63M led by SoftBank, March 2022

competitors.name: Siigo
competitors.what: Accounting and ERP software for Latam SMEs
competitors.traction_then: Acquisition of Mexico's Aspel closed February 2022, taking SME base to over 1.2 million customers

technical_complexity.rationale: Automated bookkeeping with bank feeds and classification needs integrations and accuracy checks, with human accountant review reducing the AI risk.

defensibility.rationale: Accounting incumbents in Latam were large and a classification agent can be copied; no regional data lock-in evidence.

market_need_then: Latam SMBs rely on manual or legacy systems; directories position Boton against QuickBooks, Peachtree and Zoho. No quantified demand found.

branding.domain_note: Uses botonapp.com, an app suffix variant; the exact boton.com was not shown to be owned

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence; the company site returned no usable content and the word means button in Spanish.

outcome_analysis: Boton joined YC in Summer 2022 as a three person team in Panama City selling AI assisted accounting to Latam SMBs, apparently following the founders' earlier product Hero, a Bill.com for Latam. No funding, traction, exit or shutdown is publicly documented, and the YC jobs page shows no open roles, so the outcome is unknown.
notes: The YC page lists Hero launch content but does not state that Boton is a rename or pivot of Hero, so no pivot is recorded. Company site botonapp.com returned no content. Competitors were found via a Latam accounting search, not named by Boton, and are dated 2022. Founder education and employers are null because none was found.
